images.madeBy: Alex Smith, for this bestax port
images.method: Drawn by code: docs/scripts/template-art/scenes/cv.mjs places every block and shape, and the voxel renderer in docs/scripts/template-art writes the SVG, with every texture generated from a palette and a seed. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: An invented blocky figure in a soft purple sweater and orange headphones, holding up a tablet that shows a web page, before a square orange sun framed like a selected layer, with a browser window, a code tag, a pointer, a pen curve and color swatches floating on a dotted indigo backdrop. It portrays no one.
images.replaces: public/media/background.webp, the original's portrait photo, whose source the original does not record.
